  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

cat > /tmp/make.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
s='[Si-]12(Oc3c(O1)c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c3Cl)(Oc4c(O2)c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c4Cl)O[C@H](c5ccc(C)cc5)[P+](c6ccccc6)(c7ccccc7)c8ccccn8'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('stereo',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=42; p.maxIterations=1000
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed',ret,'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
# do one forcefield optimize if available
for name,fn in [('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams),('UFF',AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams)]:
 try: print(name,fn(m))
 except Exception as e: print(e)
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('/tmp/in.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\ninitial RDKit conformer\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
PY
python /tmp/make.py
mkdir -p /tmp/xtbrun && cp /tmp/in.xyz /tmp/xtbrun/start.xyz && cd /tmp/xtbrun && xtb start.xyz --opt --gfn 2 --chrg 0 --uhf 0 --iterations 250 > xtb.log 2>&1; echo status:$?; tail -30 /tmp/xtbrun/xtb.log; ls -l /tmp/xtbrun

python - <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolTransforms
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[Si-]12(Oc3c(O1)c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c3Cl)(Oc4c(O2)c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c4Cl)O[C@H](c5ccc(C)cc5)[P+](c6ccccc6)(c7ccccc7)c8ccccn8'))
lines=open('/tmp/xtbrun/xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines(); assert int(lines[0])==m.GetNumAtoms()
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,line in enumerate(lines[2:]):
 t=line.split(); conf.SetAtomPosition(i, tuple(map(float,t[1:4])))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('after xTB',a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# distances central Si bonds
si=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Si')
print('Si index',si,[(n.GetIdx(),n.GetSymbol(),round(rdMolTransforms.GetBondLength(conf,si,n.GetIdx()),3)) for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(si).GetNeighbors()])
PY

cp /tmp/xtbrun/xtbopt.xyz answer.xyz

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('answer.xyz')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
print('exists',p.exists(),'lines',len(lines),'declared',lines[0], 'atoms',len(lines)-2)
print('\n'.join(lines[:8]))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x.split()[0] for x in lines[2:]))
assert len(lines)-2==int(lines[0])
assert all(len(x.split())==4 for x in lines[2:])
PY
